description: The price list. Read-only and free: nothing is created or charged. Returns every plan on sale (name, USD per month, credits per month, USD per credit), every one-time credit pack (credits, USD, USD per credit) and, when this account would get it at checkout, the first-purchase offer. Also returns what things cost in credits: a video, and each add-on or clip product that is switched on, with its credits per unit (per scene, or per second with the length range). Each clip tier carries creditsPerSecond and priceClass ("standard" or "lower"), which are this account's price for the SHORTEST clip of that tier, plus standardCreditsPerSecond, lowerCreditsPerSecond, approxUsdPerClipSecond and lowerPriceMaxSeconds: the lower price applies only up to lowerPriceMaxSeconds, longer clips are charged standard, and the quote tool gives the exact price of one length. The lower price is for standalone text-to-video clips only; clips made inside other products are always charged the standard price. credits.clipPriceClass says which class applies, why and how an account qualifies. Never quote standardCreditsPerSecond as the account's own price. account.usdPerCredit is what one credit costs this account in USD (usdPerCreditBasis says where the number comes from), so a credit price can be told to the user in dollars. All prices are what customers pay; tax may be added at checkout. Requires the "video:read" scope.
